XenotypeDef.label: Altmer
XenotypeDef.description: The tall, golden-skinned mer of the Summerset Isles, who count their descent from the et'Ada themselves and rarely let anyone forget it. Altmer train for centuries in magic and letters, and a single one of them may have read more than a human city. They are physically slight and they know it, which is part of why they prefer that someone else hold the front line.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: Golden-skinned mages of Summerset: long-lived, brilliant, and fragile.
